project.name: Aethel Best-In-Market 2026-2027
project.mission: Turn Aethel into a mission-first production Studio that unifies IDE, agents, repository cartography, browser operator, viewport, game/film pipelines, cloud/local runtime, and evidence-first release.
successMetrics: A new user reaches first mission artifact from Studio Home without opening advanced IDE by default.
Agent Fleet can show isolated sessions, repo scope, evidence, cost, rollback, and next action.
Repository Cartography prevents duplicate/invented work on large repositories through maps, indexes, manifests, and evidence.
Game/film mode exposes viewport, outliner, inspector, timeline, asset provenance, and validation evidence.
Browser Operator requires plan, approval, replay, pause/takeover, risk labels, and Mission Ledger evidence.
Product claims remain factual and never promise Unreal/Figma/Cursor/Manus/Adobe parity before evidence exists.

priorityDefinition.P0: Blocks the core product thesis or the next credible market demo.
priorityDefinition.P1: Creates competitive differentiation after the core mission spine works.
priorityDefinition.P2: Raises enterprise/media maturity and long-term platform breadth.

redLines: Do not claim Nanite, Lumen, Unreal parity, Premiere parity, Figma parity, Cursor parity, Manus parity, or autonomous AAA completion until acceptance evidence exists.
Do not create a separate product shell for every domain; use progressive depth from Web Light to Studio Home to Studio Cloud/Local.
Do not let chat become the product spine; mission, artifact, evidence, approval, and rollback are the spine.
Do not allow logged-in browser actions without explicit approval, replay, pause/takeover, and risk labels.
Do not treat external assets as safe until provenance, license, size, dependency, LOD, and scene usage are recorded.

epics.title: Benchmark V14 Canonical Audit
epics.rationale: Keep the product pointed at factual market-quality execution instead of stale aspiration.
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical V14 doc exists and is active.
Gate prevents stale V13 metrics from being copied as current truth.
Required competitors, categories, visual references, and red lines are covered.
Every opportunity is mapped to an epic or an explicit not-now decision.

issues.title: Maintain V14 benchmark gate as a release blocker
acceptanceCriteria: qa:best-in-market-benchmark runs in qa:product-quality-progress
Gate fails if required competitors/categories/red lines are removed

issues.title: Refresh benchmark source snapshots before major market claims
acceptanceCriteria: Official source URLs are checked before claims change
Historical/outdated inputs are explicitly marked

epics.title: Agent Fleet + Repository Cartography
epics.rationale: Aethel wins if agents can understand and work inside huge apps, games, films, assets, and repos without inventing or duplicating work.
acceptanceCriteria: Agent sessions show owner, scope, repo map, changed files, evidence, cost, rollback, and next action.
Repository Cartography supports incremental indexing, source mirrors, file manifests, asset maps, dependency maps, and stale-context warnings.
Agents must cite cartography or search evidence before large edits.
Large repo work does not block the UI thread.

issues.title: Expose Repository Cartography map in Studio and IDE context
acceptanceCriteria: User can see repo map summary, hotspots, domains, asset folders, and unknown areas
Agents can attach repo-map evidence to Mission Ledger entries

issues.title: Add isolated Agent Fleet sessions with scope and ownership
acceptanceCriteria: Each agent has a visible task, file scope, status, cost, output, and merge/review state
Agents cannot silently edit outside declared scope

issues.title: Add anti-duplication and anti-invention guardrails from cartography
acceptanceCriteria: Before creating new modules, agent checks similar files and existing contracts
Mission Ledger records why new work is not duplicate

issues.title: Support external source mirrors for very large repos and asset packs
acceptanceCriteria: Mirror metadata includes source, revision, license/provenance, size, and sync status
Large mirrors can be indexed incrementally

issues.title: Create agent handoff packets for long-running work
acceptanceCriteria: Handoff includes goal, current state, repo evidence, decisions, blockers, next commands, validation status
A new agent can resume without reading the entire repo blindly

epics.title: Studio Home Mission-First Experience
epics.rationale: The first screen must feel like Firebase/Gemini/Manus-level calm: one mission card, preview, agents, evidence, and next action without clutter.
acceptanceCriteria: First logged-in screen has one dominant mission card.
Project Brain, Mission Ledger, preview, agent status, device policy, and next action are visible but compact.
Advanced IDE depth is one click away, not forced on beginners.
Mobile companion can approve, pause, review evidence, and stop risky work.

issues.title: Refine Studio Home around one dominant mission card
acceptanceCriteria: No dashboard clutter on first view
Primary CTA starts/resumes mission
Preview and evidence are secondary but visible

issues.title: Add compact Project Brain and Mission Ledger modules to Studio Home
acceptanceCriteria: User can inspect goal, constraints, decisions, risks, latest evidence, and next action
No long text walls by default

issues.title: Add device/runtime policy card for cloud/local/NPU/GPU routing
acceptanceCriteria: UI explains whether work is cloud, local, hybrid, throttled, or paused
Heavy jobs do not surprise the user

issues.title: Define Mobile Companion approval-only MVP
acceptanceCriteria: MVP scope is review, approve, pause, stop, evidence, status
No heavy editing promises on mobile

epics.title: Game/Film Viewport Authority
epics.rationale: Aethel should not claim Unreal parity; it should make game/film work understandable, validated, and agent-operable in browser-first workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: Game/film mode makes viewport the protagonist.
Outliner, inspector, timeline, asset provenance, playtest/render evidence, and performance budget are accessible.
Every generated asset/scene/shot links to source, license, dependency, usage, validation, and approval status.

issues.title: Promote viewport layout for game/film missions
acceptanceCriteria: Viewport has primary visual weight
Outliner/inspector/timeline/chat are progressive panels, not dashboard clutter

issues.title: Add Asset Graph provenance and approval surface
acceptanceCriteria: Asset records source, license, quality, size, LOD, material, animation, dependencies, scene usage, and approval

issues.title: Add Scene/World Graph review surface
acceptanceCriteria: Scenes show levels, shots, cameras, lighting, characters, triggers, streaming, and performance budgets

issues.title: Add Gameplay Graph validation packets
acceptanceCriteria: Combat, powers, input, camera, enemies, quests, physics, progression, difficulty, and playtest criteria are tracked

issues.title: Add Shot/Film Graph validation packets
acceptanceCriteria: Script, storyboard, continuity, camera, timeline, audio, subtitles, render queue, review, and export are tracked

epics.title: Design Canvas + Figma MCP Parity
epics.rationale: Aethel should learn from Replit/Figma design-to-code without turning into a separate design app.
acceptanceCriteria: Design references can be attached to a mission.
Figma context can map components/tokens/intent to implementation tasks when configured.
Design canvas remains progressive depth, not first-screen clutter.

issues.title: Define design reference attachment model for missions
acceptanceCriteria: Mission can reference images, Figma nodes, competitor screenshots, and notes with source labels

issues.title: Create Figma MCP mapping contract for components and tokens
acceptanceCriteria: Contract explains design context, component mapping, token mapping, limitations, and review evidence

issues.title: Add design-canvas not-now boundaries
acceptanceCriteria: Doc states what Aethel will not build until core mission/viewport/agent spine is mature

epics.title: Browser Operator Manus-Style Approvals
epics.rationale: Aethel can safely help users configure domains, clouds, platforms, research, and accounts only if actions are governed and replayable.
acceptanceCriteria: Operator work has plan, permissions, replay, pause/takeover, risk labels, and Mission Ledger evidence.
Logged-in, financial, cloud, domain, deploy, and destructive actions require explicit approval.
Mission Ledger records the approved action, evidence, risk, and rollback or recovery path.

issues.title: Add Browser Operator permission manifest per mission
acceptanceCriteria: Manifest lists allowed sites, actions, credentials boundaries, approval requirements, and stop conditions

issues.title: Add Browser Operator replay and evidence ledger
acceptanceCriteria: Each step stores screenshot/log/action/result/risk/approval state

issues.title: Add pause and takeover semantics to operator UX
acceptanceCriteria: User can pause, reject, approve, or take over before risky steps

epics.title: Realtime Collaboration + Versioning
epics.rationale: Aethel needs collaboration that includes humans and agents: presence, ownership, conflicts, worktrees, merge review, and rollback.
acceptanceCriteria: Remote cursors and file presence are visible and tested.
Agent worktrees or isolated sessions expose diff, conflicts, owner, and merge review.
Rollback is visible from Mission Ledger evidence.

issues.title: Expose remote cursors and file presence in IDE
acceptanceCriteria: Two-browser e2e sees cursor and file presence
Presence is not rendered for stale users

issues.title: Add agent worktree/diff review model
acceptanceCriteria: Agent outputs are reviewable before merge
Conflict state is explicit

issues.title: Tie merge/rollback actions to Mission Ledger
acceptanceCriteria: Every merge records evidence, validation, and rollback route

epics.title: Adobe-Style Creative Media Pipeline
epics.rationale: Creative media needs variants, rights, timeline, color/export discipline, and review instead of loose generated media.
acceptanceCriteria: Media generation creates reviewable variants.
Timeline/render queue/color/export basics are tracked before professional claims.
Rights/provenance are attached to generated/imported media.

issues.title: Add creative variant review model
acceptanceCriteria: Variants include prompt, source, rights, quality notes, approval, and use target

issues.title: Define render queue MVP for film/game previews
acceptanceCriteria: Queue stores job settings, output URL/status, logs, cost, and review evidence

issues.title: Add media rights/provenance gate
acceptanceCriteria: Generated/imported media cannot be marked release-ready without provenance status

epics.title: Enterprise Trust/Billing Readiness
epics.rationale: Enterprise readiness is trust plus evidence: billing transparency, audit, reliability, procurement, incident history, and factual claims.
acceptanceCriteria: Trust, billing, audit, margin, incident posture, and procurement docs remain factual and linked.
Users can see cost, usage, risk, and release evidence without hunting through admin pages.
Marketing and sales claims are blocked when evidence, source doc, or certification status is missing.

issues.title: Create procurement-ready trust packet index
acceptanceCriteria: Index links security disclosure, reliability, billing, audit log, data policy, and incident docs

issues.title: Expose mission-level cost and margin evidence
acceptanceCriteria: Mission shows AI usage/cost budget and heavy job cost signals

issues.title: Add factual certification/claim registry
acceptanceCriteria: Marketing claims map to evidence or are blocked as not-yet-supported

epics.title: Performance, Monorepo, Local Runtime Scale
epics.rationale: To work with GB-scale repos, games, assets, and films, Aethel must index incrementally, route heavy work, and avoid freezing user devices.
acceptanceCriteria: Huge repo scans use incremental cartography, source mirrors, caching, workers, and local/cloud routing.
Device capabilities and runtime lanes are visible.
Weak devices fall back safely to cloud or throttled jobs.

issues.title: Add runtime lane policy for UI, AI, build, render, browser, and indexing jobs
acceptanceCriteria: Heavy jobs run in separate workers/queues where possible
UI thread remains responsive under long jobs

issues.title: Add device capability profile for GPU/NPU/CPU/RAM and cloud fallback
acceptanceCriteria: Profile records capability, recommended lane, fallback reason, and user-facing status

issues.title: Add GB-scale repository fixture and performance validation plan
acceptanceCriteria: Fixture plan covers huge codebase, asset pack, game scene, film timeline, and weak-device simulation

issues.title: Create cache and crash-recovery policy for Studio Local
acceptanceCriteria: Local cache, offline behavior, crash recovery, and cloud sync conflict rules are documented and testable
